title: Niten Ichi Ryu - Bukijutsu Sword Style
body:
Syntax: SWORDSTYLE Niten Ichi Ryu | SWORDSTYLE LIST | SWORDSTYLE OFF

Niten Ichi Ryu unlocks for Bukijutsu at level 140 and is learned automatically at that level. Two-sword fighting; requires a sword in each hand. A sword in BOTH wield and offhand is required.

At 100% mastery: +7 accuracy and +18% sword damage. Each landed strike costs 4 Stamina. Bonuses increase with mastery, starting at a partial strength. Use PRAC <school name> with a teacher for your initial lesson and improve it by landing ordinary sword attacks while selected. Only one sword school may be active at a time; its selection persists across logins. See HELP SWORDSTYLE for the full list.
